name: ThemeProvider
description: Mortar foundation theme provider, using central semantic tokens.

props.navigate: Optional (href: string) => void | false. Connect your router; false preserves native navigation. A nested provider without it keeps the outer router.

contract.usage: Import { ThemeProvider } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
